mainEntity.name: What data points are typically analyzed in an AEO strategy for CPAs?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AEO strategy for CPAs typically analyzes a range of data points to optimize performance. This includes website traffic sources, user behavior on the site, conversion rates for various services, keyword performance in search engines, competitor online activities, and client demographic information. AI tools process this data to uncover patterns, predict effective strategies, and recommend adjustments to content, ads, and targeting for improved client acquisition.
